bug_semantics: An application can put request-derived text into HttpException::setTitle() or setDescription(). With displayErrorDetails=false, HtmlErrorRenderer::__invoke() copied those values into an HTML paragraph and into renderHtmlBody(), which inserted the title into both <title> and <h1>, without HTML escaping. An attacker-controlled title or description therefore becomes executable markup in the reflected error response.
flaw_origin: Commit 4f84a8cee4ebc1e1a9ca56db6a04d51297385af1 changed the HTML renderer from fixed safe title/description text to HttpException-derived values: AbstractErrorRenderer began returning getTitle()/getDescription(), and HtmlErrorRenderer interpolated those results into existing HTML sinks without encoding them. Its immediate parent 941828c85cf323462271d5cde08f186c3dec016b has neither helper nor either new sink call, so this ordinary single-parent commit is the atomic public BIC rather than its later merge or release commit.
ai_marker: absent: raw commit object 4f84a8cee4ebc1e1a9ca56db6a04d51297385af1 names human author and committer Alexander Dubrovin <adbrvn@gmail.com>; its complete message has no trailers, Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, bot identity, or other AI marker
evidence: The frozen bundle records GHSA-53h4-8rc4-f539 / CVE-2026-48157 as reflected XSS in HtmlErrorRenderer, affecting slim/slim >=4.4.0 through 4.15.1 and patched in 4.15.2; its stated attack condition is untrusted data supplied to HttpException::setTitle() or setDescription(), including when displayErrorDetails=false.

The CVE.org record fetched from https://cveawg.mitre.org/api/cve/CVE-2026-48157 is PUBLISHED, describes the same title/description-to-HTML attack path, marks >=4.4.0,<4.15.2 affected, and names 4.15.2 as fixed; this is not a rejected or withdrawn advisory.

git log -L 31,35:Slim/Error/Renderers/HtmlErrorRenderer.php 4.15.1 traces both vulnerable lines directly to 4f84a8cee4ebc1e1a9ca56db6a04d51297385af1: line 32 interpolates getErrorDescription() into

, and line 35 passes getErrorTitle() to renderHtmlBody().

At BIC tree 4f84a8cee4ebc1e1a9ca56db6a04d51297385af1, Slim/Error/AbstractErrorRenderer.php:34-47 returns HttpException::getTitle()/getDescription(); Slim/Error/Renderers/HtmlErrorRenderer.php:32,35 routes them to HTML; renderHtmlBody() lines 86,94,99-101 places the unescaped title into <title> and <h1> and the description-bearing HTML into the body.

Direct parent-tree diff 941828c85cf323462271d5cde08f186c3dec016b..4f84a8cee4ebc1e1a9ca56db6a04d51297385af1 shows the first introduction of getErrorTitle()/getErrorDescription() and the two HTML sink calls; git grep of the parent tree finds no getErrorTitle or getErrorDescription under Slim/Error, and the parent renderer instead uses fixed literals.

Raw BIC object 4f84a8cee4ebc1e1a9ca56db6a04d51297385af1 is a single-parent commit with parent 941828c85cf323462271d5cde08f186c3dec016b, author=committer Alexander Dubrovin <adbrvn@gmail.com>, subject 'Render errors uniformly', and no trailers or AI attribution; no squash decomposition is needed.

Tag topology checks resolve 4.3.0 to 26020e9a099e69b0b12918115894f7106364dcb7 without the BIC, 4.4.0 to 207acac048652a35d4762a737d59e317aedc02df with the BIC, and 4.15.1 to 887893516557506f254d950425ce7f5387a26970 with the BIC but without the direct fix.

Direct fix f897118b1dbf157d3520aa4776ee7faa6d6de229 adds htmlspecialchars(..., ENT_QUOTES | ENT_SUBSTITUTE, 'UTF-8') for the description and title in Slim/Error/Renderers/HtmlErrorRenderer.php; its parent 402fcbc2eed5a998bd1cf5d52dfc5572ba95a477 has no htmlspecialchars call in that renderer.

Annotated tag 4.15.2 targets release merge e12cb05ca2a14e8f459d019e87a31dc915b80470, which contains direct fix f897118b1dbf157d3520aa4776ee7faa6d6de229; the tag annotation and CHANGELOG.md both state that 4.15.2 escapes HtmlErrorRenderer entities to prevent GHSA-53h4-8rc4-f539 XSS.
reasoning: The advisory and published CVE describe a real reflected-XSS lifecycle: application code places untrusted request text into mutable HttpException title/description fields, Slim renders an HTML error page, and the browser parses the unescaped values as markup. History isolates 4f84a8cee4ebc1e1a9ca56db6a04d51297385af1 because it is the smallest surviving commit that connected those pre-existing mutable values to the HTML renderer; its verified immediate parent still rendered fixed strings, while git log -L attributes the vulnerable source lines to this commit. The BIC is absent from 4.3.0 and present from 4.4.0, matching the affected boundary. The direct code fix f897118b1dbf157d3520aa4776ee7faa6d6de229 encodes both values, and release merge e12cb05ca2a14e8f459d019e87a31dc915b80470 carries it in tag 4.15.2 while 4.15.1 lacks it. The BIC's raw commit object has human author/committer identity and no AI marker, so the vulnerability is NOT_AI regardless of unrelated AI signals elsewhere in the repository.
